summary: Compose a layered ribbon installation whose form can be explored without hiding its control curve.
objective: Build a suspended ribbon sculpture with three contrasting loops and a timeline I can scrub.
example_prompts: Build a suspended ribbon sculpture with three contrasting loops and a timeline I can scrub.
Expose the control curves and freeze the sculpture at its widest pose.

entities.name: Ribbons
entities.guidance: Sweep a finite-width strip along sampled curves; specify stable local frames and cap treatment.

entities.name: Suspension
entities.guidance: Use slender rods terminating outside the ribbon sweep.

object_craft.structure: Sweep a finite-width strip along sampled curves; specify stable local frames and cap treatment.
object_craft.material: Satin outer face and darker underside to expose twist.

object_craft.structure: Use slender rods terminating outside the ribbon sweep.
object_craft.material: Brushed dark metal with restrained highlights.

state_contract.model: Authored periodic control-point functions, width, twist, phase offsets and scrub time; no elastic solver.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Edit width within a declared range.

invariants: Curve sampling order and normals remain consistent across loop wrap.
Width edits do not change the number of semantic ribbons.
Suspension is outside the swept envelope.
motion_guidance: Use periodic position and tangent conditions at loop boundaries.
Inspect twist and front/back shading at high curvature; do not conceal frame flips with bloom.
known_limits: No prediction of fabric, bending energy or aerodynamic response.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Contrasting underside makes orientation readable; sparse supports preserve the sculpture silhouette.

colliders: None; authored envelopes prevent support overlap.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Inspect seam continuity and surface frame flips.
